mechanics.name: Lucifron's Curse
mechanics.note: Curse on everyone in range: every spell and ability costs double until it is taken off.

mechanics.name: Dominate Mind
mechanics.note: Magic charm; whoever it lands on fights the raid until it is dispelled.

mechanics.name: Impending Doom
mechanics.note: Shadow damage to everyone near him a few seconds after the cast; anyone who can leave should be gone before it lands.

mechanics.name: Shadow Shock
mechanics.note: Lashes everything in range at once; a ranged player taking it was standing too close.
